slots.name: hungry families share
slots.sentence: Three-in-four families in parts of Yemen are going hungry from the "absolutely devastating" impact of a surge in fighting, which has displaced tens of thousands of people and disrupted supplies to millions, the World Food Programme said on Friday.

slots.name: government-held population
slots.sentence: The total population of government-held areas is estimated at around 10 million people.

slots.name: food import share
slots.sentence: Prices of basic food staples such as wheat flour and vegetable oil are rising in a country that imports around 90% of its food.

slots.name: insufficient food households
slots.sentence: Within just a few weeks, the fighting has driven the share of households without sufficient food to 74% in government-controlled areas accessible to WFP

slots.name: territory seized
slots.sentence: The Houthis, who already control most of northern Yemen including the capital Sanaa, seized the country's entire Red Sea coast last month from Saudi-backed forces of the internationally recognised government, based in the southern port of Aden.
